guidebook.intro: Jamii ina mizizi mirefu: majirani huchangia pamoja, mikutano ni mirefu na kila mtu ana sauti.

tips.title: Vote na election
body: **Kura** ni **vote**, na **kupiga kura** ni **to vote** (si “beat a vote”). **Uchaguzi** ni **election**: **There’s an election next year.**
**Serikali** ni **the government**. **Kiongozi** ni **leader**: **Our leader spoke at the meeting.**

tips.title: Each other
body: **-ana** ya Kiswahili (**tunapendana**) ni **each other** kwa Kiingereza: **We love each other**, **They help each other**.
**Tusaidiane** ni **Let’s help each other!** Na **tutaonana** ni **we’ll see each other** au kwa kawaida **see you**.

culture.title: Fundraiser
body: Harambee kwa Kiingereza ni **a fundraiser**. Kuchangia ni **to contribute** au **to give**: **Everyone gave what they could.**
